epics.name: Unified Task Inbox
epics.description: One inbox combining system-derived application and payment tasks with manual tasks, with list/calendar views, filters and sidebar counts.

epics.name: Manual Tasks & Meetings
epics.description: Creation, assignment, meetings and status lifecycle of user-created tasks.

epics.name: Decisions from Tasks
epics.description: Taking workflow and payment decisions directly from the inbox, individually or in bulk by committee minute.

epics.name: Focus Mode
epics.description: Distraction-free, one-task-at-a-time processing with a persistent timer.

features.name: Derived application stage tasks
features.description: Compute a task for each pending application at a stage the user supervises/secretaries (or all for admin/GM), with SLA due date.

Due = entered + SLA

rules.rule: Only manual tasks are stored (manual_tasks); application and payment tasks are derived on the fly from live workflow/payment state and are never persisted — no duplicated task status.
An application task exists for an application when status='pending', current_stage is set, stage_status ≠ 'needs_edit', and the application belongs to the user's tenant.

The application task is assigned to the user if they are in the current stage's supervisor_ids, are the stage's committee secretary, or have role admin or grants_manager (elevated: sees all pending stage tasks of the tenant).
Application task due date = stage_entered_at + stage.sla_days (default 3 calendar days).
Application task identity is application + stage number (a new task per stage); its stageKey groups committee stages by committee name, other stages by program:stage.

A payment task exists when payment.status='awaiting_approval' and the project belongs to the user's tenant; it is assigned per PAYMENT_APPROVAL_CHAIN[approval_step]: step 0 project manager (only the project's manager_id), step 1 grants_manager role, step 2 ceo role; admin sees every step.
Payment task due date = payment.due_date; derived tasks always have status 'todo' and disappear once the underlying item moves on.
Manual task title is required, 1–200 characters (client and DB CHECK); status ∈ todo, in_progress, done (DB CHECK, default todo).
A manual task's assignee must have an active persona_membership in the same tenant.
A user loads manual tasks of their tenant where they are assignee, creator or meeting attendee.
Scope 'mine' = all derived tasks + manual tasks assigned to me or where I am an attendee; scope 'delegated' = manual tasks I created and assigned to someone else.
Meeting fields (start time, location/link, attendees) are saved only when kind='meeting'; attendees exclude the assignee; the creator is preserved on edit.
Kind filter tabs are mutually exclusive: meetings count only under «المواعيد», plain manual tasks under «يدوية»; tabs with zero items are hidden except «الكل» and the active tab.
A task is overdue when not done and due date < today (UTC date); late text shows days late (minimum 1).
Sort 'due' orders by due date ascending with undated last; 'new' orders by creation date descending (payment tasks use due date as creation date).

Return and reject decisions require a reason (≤1000 chars); approval note is optional unless the application is 'risky' — AI recommendation contains «لا يوصى» or AI score < program pass_score (default 80) — then a justification note is mandatory.
Application tasks offer approve / return / reject (approveStage, returnStage, closeApplication); payment tasks offer approve / reject only, where reject sends the payment back to 'due' at step 0.
Bulk selection is available only on committee-stage application tasks where the user is the stage's secretary; all selected tasks must share the same stageKey (same committee/stage).
Focus queue = all non-meeting tasks, manual ones only when assigned to me, open only, sorted by due date; skipped tasks go to the end; skip is disabled when fewer than 2 tasks remain.
In focus mode manual tasks can only be completed (→ done); derived tasks can be approved or returned with a note (note mandatory for return); no reject action.

The focus timer resets only when the current task changes; paused time is excluded; the session (active, open, task, timer, skipped) persists in localStorage 'focus:session' across navigation and reload.
Exit (or Escape) hides the overlay and keeps the session running with a floating pill; «إنهاء وضع التركيز» clears the session.
Focus mode counts tasks done today per persona per device (localStorage key focus:done:<persona>:<date>) and shows a Riyadh-time clock (fixed UTC+3) with Hijri (Umm al-Qura) and Gregorian dates.
Sidebar counts use the same derivation: /tasks = all open tasks in scope 'mine'; /reviewer = open application tasks; /projects and /finance = open payment tasks.
Saved view stores view, kind filter, scope and sort per user (never the search text).
Manual status changes are not restricted to the assignee: the update matches on the task's own assigned_to, so any user who sees the task (creator, attendee) can change it or edit it.

issues.description: Focus mode offers «إعادة بملاحظة» on payment tasks, but decide() maps any non-approve decision on payments to approvePayment(false) — a rejection that resets the payment to 'due', step 0. Label misrepresents the action.
issues.recommendation: Label as «رفض» for payments or implement distinct return semantics.

issues.description: Focus-mode approval bypasses the AI-risk mandatory-justification guard enforced in the inbox approval sheet.
issues.recommendation: Move the guard into the shared decide() or service layer (FR-TSK-037).

issues.description: Focus mode has no reject action for applications, unlike the inbox.
issues.recommendation: Add reject with mandatory reason or document intentional omission.

issues.description: Anyone who can see a manual task (creator, attendee) can edit it and change its status; changeManualTaskStatus does not check the acting user; RLS open.
issues.recommendation: Define edit rights (OQ-TSK-02) and enforce server-side.

issues.description: No delete/cancel for manual tasks or meetings.
When a search matches nothing, the 'no tasks' empty state replaces the whole toolbar including the search box, so the user cannot clear the search (state not saved; only reload helps).
issues.recommendation: Apply empty state only before search/filter; keep toolbar visible.

issues.description: Applications, stages and payments are fetched for all tenants and filtered client-side; derivation runs on every page via navCounts — performance and data-exposure risk.
issues.recommendation: Server-side task query/view scoped by tenant and user.

issues.description: Bulk payment decision (bulkDecidePayments) is wired but unreachable because isSecretaryTask returns false for payment tasks; hint text says payments can be selected.
issues.recommendation: Decide whether payment minutes are needed; remove or enable.

issues.description: Page meta mentions Kanban and saved view defaults include 'board' and 'source' options that do not exist in the UI.
issues.recommendation: Remove stale options or implement board/source filter.

issues.description: Payment tasks use due_date (or empty) as createdAt, making «الأحدث إضافة» sorting meaningless for payments.
issues.recommendation: Use the time the payment entered the current step.

issues.description: Overdue and calendar 'today' use UTC date (toISOString) while focus clock uses fixed UTC+3; tasks may show wrong overdue state around midnight Riyadh time.
For admin/grants manager, derived tasks for stages they do not own are shown with themselves as assignee, hiding the actual responsible supervisors; inflates their counts.
issues.recommendation: Show actual stage owners; separate oversight view.

issues.description: No derived tasks for finance (awaiting_transfer) or partner receipts, and reviewers/finance only see what stages assign; finance's «مهامي» may be empty although it owns payment execution.
Nav count key '/finance' is computed but no role's sidebar has a /finance item.
issues.recommendation: Remove or map to an existing item.

issues.description: Editor falls back to all tenant personas as colleagues when the memberships query is empty, but saving then fails the active-membership check.
issues.recommendation: Use one source for assignable users.

issues.description: Done-today counter and focus time are device-local (localStorage) and not attributable or reportable.
issues.recommendation: Persist server-side if used for performance (OQ-TSK-12).

issues.description: No notifications/reminders for new, overdue or SLA-breaching tasks.

open_questions.question: Should manual tasks/meetings support delete or cancel, comments and attachments?
Who may edit a manual task or change its status: creator, assignee, attendees?
Should grants managers/admins see all stage tasks as their own, or in a separate oversight view?
For payments, are 'return for correction' and 'reject' different outcomes?
Is the 3-day default SLA correct, and should SLA be in business days (Saudi weekend/holidays)?
Should focus mode support reject and enforce the AI-risk justification rule?
Are email/push notifications or reminders required for new and overdue tasks?
Which payment steps after approval (transfer, receipt) should create tasks and for whom?
Should meetings integrate with external calendars and allow external (partner) attendees?
Should committee minutes also be possible for payment approvals from tasks?
Is a Kanban board view required (mentioned in page metadata)?
Should focus-mode time and completions be stored for productivity reporting?
